name: DoughBoy's Grill
notes: Own site (doughboysgrill.com) blocks with HTTP 409; filed from Uber Eats JSON-LD instead. Address matches exactly (4994 Newport Avenue, A). Yelp tags this CLOSED but Uber Eats, Postmates, Instagram (@doughboys_grill_ob) and a 2026 "Best of Ocean Beach" nomination all show it actively operating with a current menu, so the Yelp closed tag was treated as stale. Divisor sweep flagged 1.20 at 68%, but dividing landed prices at x.99 (e.g. 17.99/1.2=14.992), not on whole dollars, so this is a false positive of the round-cents check (charm pricing already ends in .19/.39/.59/.79/.99, a 20-cent ladder, which any divisor near 1 maps onto a similarly-shaped fraction) rather than evidence of a real fee markup. Filed as-is. Excluded 3 free $0.00 condiments (Ketchup, Crushed Red Pepper, Parmesan Cheese) from the dish list.
